title: Plugin submission
description: What a publisher sends to the center. Every field is a claim to be re-resolved against the forge, not a value to be trusted: the worker fetches the commit, tree, and archive itself and compares.

repository.description: Canonical HTTPS URL. No query, fragment, credentials, or non-forge host.

ref.description: A full commit SHA or refs/tags/<tag>. An annotated tag is resolved through to its commit.

commit.description: What the ref resolved to locally. Compared against the forge, never used in its place.

mode.description: publisher-release verifies and re-hosts the publisher's own bytes; center-build ignores them and builds from the pin.

allOf.description: A publisher-supplied artifact is only usable if its bytes can be identified before download.

permissions.description: Declared for the permission diff. The packaged manifest is authoritative and overrides a disagreement.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable per (plugin, version, commit, artifact). A redelivered submission must not create a second release.
